$comment: Index of Preset MCP gateway client connection templates. Templates carry the endpoint only: no credentials, tokens, client IDs, or client secrets. Verified against each vendor's official documentation on the date below; re-verify before changing a template.

clients.name: Claude Code
clients.destination: .mcp.json at the project root (project scope), or use the CLI command
clients.cli: claude mcp add --transport http preset-gateway https://mcp.app.preset.io/mcp
clients.signIn: Run /mcp in Claude Code (or claude mcp login preset-gateway) and complete the browser sign-in.

clients.name: Cursor
clients.signIn: Open Cursor MCP settings and authenticate the server in the browser when prompted.

clients.name: VS Code (GitHub Copilot)
clients.destination: .vscode/mcp.json in the workspace, or run MCP: Add Server
clients.signIn: VS Code opens a browser for authorization on the first connection to the server.

clients.name: OpenAI Codex (CLI, IDE extension, ChatGPT desktop app)
clients.signIn: Run codex mcp login preset-gateway and complete the browser sign-in.

clients.name: Claude (claude.ai and Claude Desktop)
clients.manualSteps: Customize > Connectors > + Add > Add custom connector. Enter a name and the endpoint URL, then Continue. Leave the OAuth identity on Use Claude's published identity (Recommended), or Register automatically. Do not choose Use your own OAuth client unless a Preset administrator issued that client to you. On Team and Enterprise plans an Owner adds the connector and members then click Connect.

clients.name: ChatGPT
clients.manualSteps: Open ChatGPT Plugins, select the plus button, then Add custom MCP server. Enter a name and description and the endpoint URL including the /mcp path, then configure authentication, review the risk warning, and create it. Availability depends on the ChatGPT plan and workspace settings.
